messages:
incident-bot: ALERT 1775123456 - eu-west3 GPU pool degraded: driver resets and memory evictions increasing rapidly — paging infra-oncall
sara: seeing a big bump in queue retries and 5xxs for hosted-text-gen in eu-west3 :grimacing: jose can you check node-level errors?
jose: on it. kernel driver reset spam in dmesg, starting at 1775123400. about 40% of g5 nodes reporting repeated NV driver timeouts. grabbing crash logs and recent rollout history
tam: can we do a partial traffic diversion to avoid cascading failures? propose moving safest routes (non-urgent batch jobs + low-SLA customers) to eu-west1 first
sara: yes please. gradated ramp — avoid big shock to eu-west1/eu-central. start with 25% then 60 then 90 if needed
rachel: ops note: cross-region egress will spike for some customers during shifts; flagging billing/pm if shift >30m
jose: preparing the shift command. also will isolate three noisy hosts to stop eviction churn

# shift low-priority hosted traffic to eu-west1
rwctl routing update --route=hosted-lowpri --targets=eu-west1:25,eu-central:0 --duration=10m --ramp=linear
# temporarily reduce per-device concurrency in target region
rwctl config set --region=eu-west1 --concurrency.per_device=2 --batching.max_tokens=800

jose: kicked shift at 1775123480
sara: thanks. can we also enable a short-circuit fallback to quantized variants for the hosted route if region health <60%? reduces memory pressure
tam: agree. also we should tweak pagerbot to avoid noisy pages for short blips. current rule pages infra-oncall for any eviction spike >40% for 1m — that's too chatty during rollouts
sara: proposal for pagerbot rules:
```
pagerbot.rules.infra:
  - condition: evictions_rate > 50% and sustained_for > 5m
    page: infra-oncall
  - condition: evictions_rate > 50% and sustained_for <= 5m
    notify: ops-channel (no page)
  - condition: evictions_rate > 50% and queue_depth > 400
    page: infra-oncall
```
rachel: prefer combining metrics (evictions + queue depth) rather than evictions alone. also add suppression for deploy windows
jose: shift shows eu-west1 latency OK, eu-central slight rise. isolating three nodes removed noisy evictions, autoscaler requested 4 replacements but cloud quota check shows 20m delay
sara: keep shift active. increase low-pri shift to 60% for 15m while we wait on new nodes
jose: updated ramp to 60% at 1775123560
ops-bot: UPDATE 1775123580 - routing change applied, fallback policy set to use quantized variants when region_healthy_gpus < 60%, node isolation performed, replacements requested
tam: handoff plan: sara will brief the next oncall at 19:00Z, i'll be secondary. please prepare a 1-paragraph summary and attach current dashboards
sara: ack. summary I'll post in #incidents and link the runbook. follow-ups: (1) modify pager thresholds per above, (2) add auto-fallback to quantized models for sustained eviction storms, (3) improve pre-warm capacity when eviction_rate > X for Y minutes
rachel: I'll open the billing ticket for cross-region egress impact if shift extends beyond 30m
jose: cloud quota cleared, new nodes expected in ~18m. monitoring eviction rate and queue depth
sara: thanks all. closing thread for now, will reopen if infra-oncall needs to re-escalate. :thumbsup:
